say: They kept watch, every kingdom, each its own way. Lamps, eyes, iron, silence, memory.
Read me their tablets, %1$s. I only remember them happy.
Five kingdoms, five watches, and not one of them knew what it was watching for.
Their guards still keep their posts in their streets. Be gentle with their people, %1$s, or the guards will remember you.
Things came undone around them, %1$s. Never there at all. Only near the black stones did nothing go missing.
Something is working the Nails loose. It is patient. I can feel it at the edge of everything I know.
